topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: The news shadows my heart like a thick fog over the moor. It seems the thing I crafted with my own hands and sweat, that plow that turns the earth so fine, someone else has already shown it to the town crier and taken the king’s seal. All the while, I toiled and thought my labor would bring not only bread to the table but perhaps a few extra coins to ease the yoke. Now, the soil feels colder beneath my feet. The saints above, perhaps they do not look kindly on a poor man’s toil. I wonder how the seed I plant this spring will sprout, if at all, when the harvest seems shadowed by this new cloud.
